The department email list was never designed for operational intelligence.

Critical ATIs get buried under shift schedules and administrative notices. Officers miss updates they needed before their last traffic stop. Supervisors have no visibility into what was read, by whom, and when. Every agency knows the problem. Nobody has fixed it, until now.

How it works

Built for the way police departments operate.

Tiered Notifications
Four priority tiers, from immediate officer safety alerts to routine patrol guidance, each with distinct notification behavior so officers always know what demands attention right now.
Structured Intelligence Feed
ATIs, ATLs, RFIs, CIAC bulletins, stolen vehicles, directed patrol. Each content type in its own lane. No digging through email chains. No missed critical updates buried in inbox clutter.
Warrant Database
Searchable, CBI-synced warrant records on every officer's iPhone. Name and DOB search with full warrant detail, available on a traffic stop without a radio call.
Distribution & Submission Console
A web console for the full intelligence loop. Personnel can submit tips, ATLs, ATIs, RFIs, and field observations. Intelligence is distributed to the right officers, in the right districts, with expiration controls and acknowledgment tracking built in.
